nodes_in_topological_order: N0 r4 contract plus its member and outer seals
N1 fresh r4 contract static hammer plus member and outer seals
N2 immutable runner Python and shell
N3 runner static hammer plus member and outer seals
N4 launch candidate hammer plus member and outer seals
N5 final release hammer plus member and outer seals
N6 canonical authorization JSON plus member and outer seals
N8 wrapper static/release hammer plus member and outer seals
edges: N2 freezes only canonical paths for N0,N1,N3,N4,N5,N6 and N8; N2 does not freeze any later object SHA
N4 binds N0,N1,N2,N3 and frozen inputs
N5 binds N0,N1,N2,N3,N4 and result/attempt absence
N6 binds N0,N1,N2,N3,N4,N5 and result/attempt absence
N7 binds exact N2 SHA and exact N6 JSON/member/outer-seal SHA; N7 freezes only canonical N8 path, not N8 SHA
N8 binds N0 through N7, N7 self SHA and result/attempt absence
N9 is legal only after N7 and N2 independently validate N8/N6 and all recursively bound earlier bytes
forbidden_edges: N2 embedding N6 JSON, member-sidecar or outer-seal SHA
N6 embedding N7 or N8 identity
N8 requiring a later author-generated permit
any self-hash field or mutation of an earlier node after a later node binds it

immutable_runner_contract.required_direct_invocation_guard: Runner rejects before result/attempt creation unless invoked by the reviewed wrapper and given a read-only descriptor containing the already verified canonical authorization path and wrapper review path.
runner_runtime_revalidation: strict duplicate-key and non-finite rejection for authorization and every JSON review
authorization JSON member-sidecar and outer seal
runner own Python and shell SHA equal authorization-bound values
contract, contract-static, runner-static, candidate and final-release member/review/manifest/outer-seal identities equal authorization-bound values
M511 payload, payload-verifier and decoder-weight package member/outer seals
canonical result and attempt marker both absent
wrapper descriptor path is canonical and wrapper review is strict PASS with launch_now true

canonical_authorization_schema.authoring_stage: Only after N5 final-release hammer is complete and double-sealed.

post_authorization_launcher_wrapper_sche.authoring_stage: Only after N6 canonical authorization JSON/member/outer-seal bytes are immutable.
wrapper_freezes_exact: canonical authorization JSON path and SHA
canonical authorization member-sidecar path and file SHA
canonical authorization outer-seal path and file SHA
post_authorization_launcher_wrapper_sche.wrapper_self_check: At runtime compute SHA of $0 and compare it to the wrapper_sha256 field inside the canonical independently double-sealed wrapper review.
post_authorization_launcher_wrapper_sche.wrapper_review_check: Strictly parse the canonical review; verify review.md/review.json membership, exact SHA256SUMS and outer seal; require score=100, P0=0, P1=0, launch_now=true and exact wrapper/auth/runner identities.
post_authorization_launcher_wrapper_sche.wrapper_prelaunch_recheck: Rehash the authorization triple and every authorization-bound earlier object, verify result/attempt absence, then pass only the canonical read-only authorization descriptor to the immutable runner.
post_authorization_launcher_wrapper_sche.failure_before_attempt: Any mismatch exits before result directory and attempt marker creation.

required_bindings: authorization JSON/member/outer-seal paths and file SHA values
runner Python/shell paths and SHA values
contract-static, runner-static, launch-candidate and final-release review member/manifest/outer-seal identities
result path absent and attempt marker absent

one_process_phase_machine.action: wrapper and runner independently verify the full identity DAG, exact inputs, absent result/attempt and all six resident/terminal golden hashes
validate complete S10x4xT10 A1 ledgers, select one fixed strongest A1 under frozen tie order, double-seal receipt
rehash A1 receipt and execute immutable PBR4 with the identical terminal FSM
apply unchanged gates and atomically double-seal finite result

failure_semantics.preflight_failure: No result directory, no attempt marker, no attempt consumption.
failure_semantics.post_attempt_failure: Attempt consumed; staging is double-sealed FAILED_OR_INCOMPLETE and quarantined; canonical result absent.
